summary:
w173 accepts supervision#r98, but there is no accepted scenario for it: features/ has no @r98 tag (I checked; both research stages found the same).
The formulate round for supervision (i25, round 3) returned r98 as a question and made no commit. Even so, the capability-proposal .shop/work/i25/supervision.md is marked formulated.
With no scenario, the implementer has nothing to see red. 'pytest --work-item w173' refuses because w173 accepts none of the scenarios it collects (r56), so the work-item cannot go green.
The spec settles the content: the Implementation line for r98 and the proposal's answers 1 (a) and 2 (a) say the brief names the findings file of the work-item's last review stage directory, writes the answer as r57 does, and covers only a work-item's reviewer.
r98's route to ready also depends on work-queue r26-r28 (the --change/--accept flag and the refusal without it). Those are w174's, which is awaiting-answer and not in code yet. Today a reviewer's answer lands at done (research probe D1).
What is needed: a formulate round that writes the @r98 scenario in features/supervision.feature, now that work-queue r14/r26-r28 are applied, and w174 landing before w173 is planned again.
No plan.md was written, as NEEDS_CONTEXT requires.
